items.title: No steering wheel, no problem: Can Tesla speed by Cybercab probe?
items.summary: Federal investigators have opened an investigation into whether Tesla's (TSLA) new Cybercabs comply with federal safety standards, just as the company begins testing its service in Austin, Texas.  Market Domination host Josh Lipton is joined by Tom Narayan, RBC Capital Markets lead equity analyst for global autos, to discuss if the investigation jeopardizes the rollout and how Tesla is also trying to avoid an "Apple Maps moment."

items.title: Tesla (TSLA) Faces NHTSA Cybercab Safety Probe After Austin Robotaxi Rollout
items.summary: US National Highway Traffic Safety Administration opens investigation into Tesla (NasdaqGS:TSLA) Cybercab robotaxi safety compliance after commercial rollout in Austin, Texas. Probe centers on whether Cybercab vehicles without traditional steering wheels and pedals meet federal motor vehicle safety standards. items.title: Tesla (TSLA) Stock Trades Down, Here Is Why
items.summary: Shares of electric vehicle pioneer Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) fell 6% in the afternoon session after U.S. safety regulators said they were evaluating the rollout of the company's new Cybercab, compounding a sell-the-news reaction to a launch event.
